summary: R07-R14 recovery closure plus one new inbound channel. Code: control-card {label,token} contract end to end with a typed ENCODE_ERROR over the 64-byte callback cap (R07); Telegram callback chat type read from the real chat and ACK only after the durable receipt (R09); /pair redemption injected by the composition root and /unpair revoking only the caller (R10); Host event return path in src/runtime/host-return.mjs (turn.output/completed/failed -> control reply, interaction.opened -> interaction + card, session.closed -> cancel) (R11); inbound media admitted through MediaService into Host.saveAttachment before submit, never the token URL (R12); control-send idempotency by requestId with per-segment evidence (R13); interaction TTL never extends a past deadline, future cap = min(host, now+15min) (R14); new T21 WxPusher provider (outbound send + Host-mounted callback with route/uid/pairing auth) wired into the provider registry. Docs: CHANGELOG, HANDOFF, docs/PROGRESS.md and docs/architecture.md updated. Verification: npm run check passes (74 source files); npm test 383 pass / 0 fail (73 protocol). Real devices/accounts remain out of scope; this is not a push authorization by itself.
